voci.I quattro passi in ordine: cosa catturar: The four steps in order: what to capture, where are the subtitles, the audio, how to read. It's the only one you need before pressing Start.
voci.Il gioco dev'essere in finestra o senza: The game must be windowed or borderless, not full screen exclusively. By choosing the window instead of the screen, nothing else fits into the frame that goes to OCR — not even our windows, which the program otherwise ends up reading.
voci.Il gioco deve stare in finestra o senza: The game must be windowed or borderless, not full screen exclusively.
voci.Il programma ascolta una scheda audio pe: The program listens to one sound card to hear the game and uses another to let you hear the dubbed voice. You don't need a microphone and you don't need any cables: Windows already knows how to listen to what a card is playing.
voci.Il programma ascolta una scheda per sent: The program listens to one card to hear the game and plays on another to let you hear your voice. You don't need a microphone. If you don't know what to choose, press «I don't have Voicemeeter».
voci.Il programma si e' aperto nella lingua i: The program opened in the language you use Windows in. If it's not the one you want, change it here: change immediately, without restarting anything.
voci.Il registro dal vivo: chi parla, con che: The live recording: who speaks, with what voice, how much it took. And the three steps still to be taken, while there are any.
voci.Il vantaggio si sente subito: il rettang: The advantage is immediately noticeable: the subtitle rectangle is relative to the window, so if you move the game the area follows it.
voci.L'audio: cosa sente il programma, e dove: The audio: what the program hears, and where it plays
voci.L'unica regola e' che le due non siano l: The only rule is that the two are not the same card. If they were, the dubbed voice would come back into the capture, get dubbed again, and in two seconds you'd have a whistle. The program notices this and does not start.

voci.La prima cosa da guardare e' il registro: The first thing to look at is the register, in the "Session" tab: one color per character, because the question you ask yourself when looking at it is not "what did he say" but "is it always the same one speaking?".
voci.La seconda e' la barra in fondo alla fin: The second is the bar at the bottom of the window: readings per second, beats, latency, compression, underrun. The only red is an underrun, and it's not an abnormal number: it's a joke that hasn't been heard.
voci.La voce arriva sempre un po' dopo il sot: The voice always comes a little after the subtitle, and this is intentional: half a second is used to understand who is speaking before choosing the voice. Measured live: approx. 670 ms with Piper, approx. 1150 ms with Kokoro.
